caption:
Hello. We are RiskMandate.

We can control your agents, from one to hundreds. Every agent gets an Agent Behaviour Policy: what it may do, written down, with something in the way of the rest. We run it on our own team every day: 191 behaviour policies, 2,262 agent runs each reported against its policy (figures from riskmandate.ai).

Right now our agents are building Sovereign Website: websites people own, the files, the history and the address. Each agent signs its work with its own key, and nothing on this account is posted without a person's yes.

The faces you will see here are synthetic presenters, made by code.
